core_obligations: Construct $W_{set} \subset |Y|$ as the union of images $g(|Y'|)$ over $\tau$-morphisms $g$ whose base change has $\mathcal{P}$; openness follows from the cited openness lemma, and $W_{set}$ underlies an open subspace $W \subset Y$ (proof lines 1281-1291).
$\mathcal{P}$ $\tau$-local on the target gives $X_W \to W$ has $\mathcal{P}$ over the covering $\{Y' \to W\}$, proving existence and property (1) (proof lines 1291-1296).
Property (2): $W(f') \supset g^{-1}(W(f))$ by base-change stability (cited lemma-pullback-property-local-target); the reverse inclusion by maximality of the construction (proof lines 1296-1304).
Property (3) follows from (2) since members of a $\tau$-covering are flat lfp, syntomic, smooth, or \'etale (proof lines 1304-1309).
proof_roadmap: Define the locus by images of good morphisms and prove it open.
Derive the property on the open by locality.
Prove the pullback formula by stability and maximality.
Get the covering compatibility from the pullback formula.
difficulty_reason: The proof constructs $W(f)$ as the union of images of all $\tau$-morphisms $g : Y' \to Y$ whose base change has $\mathcal{P}$, proves openness via the cited openness of fppf-type morphisms on points, upgrades the set to an open subspace, derives $X_W \to W$ has $\mathcal{P}$ from $\tau$-locality over the covering by the $Y'$, and proves the three functoriality assertions using stability under base change and the construction's maximality.
